purpose: Validation-only exploratory LoRA adaptation with a shared MLP head and raw-statistics ablation after E01C attribution controls.

architecture.head: per-sample LayerNorm(moment)/sqrt(1024); training-fitted raw-statistics standardization/sqrt(15); concatenate; Linear(1039,128), GELU, dropout, Linear(128,3)
architecture.branch_ablation: Use the same head topology and initialization; zero the excluded branch. Nominal parameter equality does not imply equal effective capacity.
architecture.base_dropout_mode: eval; adapter and classifier dropout train only
architecture.pooling: existing mask-aware mean with complete-patch validity
architecture.backbone: same verified public MOMENT checkpoint; all base parameters frozen

training.scheduler: per-update linear warmup plus cosine decay, fixed maximum epoch budget
training.checkpoint_selection: highest validation Macro-F1; earliest exact tie; patience min_delta does not discard a higher scoring checkpoint
training.resume: epoch boundary with learned state, optimizer/scaler and CPU/CUDA/shuffle RNG states
training.nonfinite_policy: fail loudly on nonfinite logits/loss/gradient norm; no silent precision changes or parameter-range changes

decision_rules.rank_selection: Among qualifying fusion candidates choose highest validation Macro-F1; within 0.01 pp prefer lower rank.

limitations: Seed43 reference validation outcomes are already known and reused. This is an exploratory single-seed 40% pilot, not independent confirmation. Validation labels (3510) supplement training labels (9827). Neural heads use epoch-level validation and two predeclared ranks, unlike the older training-CV SVM protocol; search budgets are disclosed, not claimed identical. Pretrained-vs-random attribution from E01C is conditional and is not a new LoRA random-initialization control. No test inference, no automatic replication or full finetuning.
